visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person with dark, wavy hair and large black sunglasses wears a red and white horizontal striped t-shirt. They stand against a plain, off-white wall. In their hands, they hold several square cards with colorful cartoon illustrations of hands and faces. The lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor setting. The camera is static, capturing a medium shot of the person from the chest up as they display the cards. (2) The scene transitions to an indoor retail environment resembling a supermarket aisle stocked with various packaged food products. The person is now holding multiple boxes of crackers and snacks against their chest. Later, the setting shifts to a cinema lobby with posters and promotional materials in the background. The person wears the same outfit and sunglasses, making hand gestures like peace signs while interacting with unseen staff. (3) A series of close-up shots feature different colorful cards with cartoon characters being tapped onto a digital payment terminal or countertop. The hands are clearly visible against a blurred background of store interiors. Then, the video cuts to screen recordings of a mobile application interface showing digital forms, credit card details, and branding logos. The visual pace is rapid, with quick cuts between the physical cards and the digital screen captures. (4) The person appears in various outdoor and storefront locations, including a 7-Eleven, a pharmacy, and other retail shops. They perform energetic, exaggerated dance-like movements and funny walks while holding a white credit card towards the camera. The backgrounds are diverse, showing street-level views of storefronts, sidewalks, and shelves. The lighting is mostly natural daylight or bright artificial store lights. In the final scene, they are indoors, holding a convenience store food bowl.

Several sharp, high-frequency sound effects like digital 'dings' and 'whooshes' are layered over the speech to mark transitions. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous skit about a 'frugal friend' to introduce and promote the CTBC Uniopen icash Pay co-branded credit card. It highlights various cashback benefits and rewards at popular Taiwanese retailers like 7-Eleven, Cosmed, and Simple Mart through high-energy narration and fast-paced editing.
